mutant.lineText: const canon = (v: unknown): string => (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? `{${Object.keys(v).sort().filter((k) => (v as Record<string, unknown>)[k] !== undefined).map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canon((v as Record<string, unknown>)[k])}`).join(',')}}` : Array.isArray(v) ? `[${v.map(canon).join(',')}]` : JSON.stringify(v));
mutant.prevText: /** Stable encoding with keys sorted at every level. */
